title: Patronus and native cloud browser evaluation
primary_question: For which task, domain, and session conditions does Patronus complete the same user task more reliably or with less effort than native cloud Chrome?

native_cloud_chrome.label: Native interactive cloud Chrome
native_cloud_chrome.capability_gate: Inspect current supported browser APIs. User desktop is not the comparator.

patronus_reader_auto.label: Patronus auto reader
patronus_reader_auto.role: optional routing strategy; never pool with forced browser

patronus_desktop.label: Patronus headed desktop browser
patronus_desktop.capability_gate: Desktop/handoff described in project context; callable interaction surface was not verified. Do not invent an API. Mark capability unavailable until discovered and authorized.

web_text.label: Web textual fetch
web_text.role: secondary diagnostic baseline only; never called built-in interactive browser

warm_public.cache: same dedicated profile after exactly one unscored priming load

warm_authenticated.auth: same authorized account/entitlements on both arms

public_observed.caution: Practical product behavior only; not evidence of a cold/warm or engine-only advantage.

design.stopping_rule: Fixed 12 matched pairs per registered stratum. Examine confirmatory routing once at the end; extra or adaptive samples are exploratory unless a new design is preregistered.
design.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar on discordant complete pairs; no cross-case confirmatory claim without multiplicity correction
design.randomization: seeded case order and counterbalanced AB/BA within each case/profile; log actual timing

cases.name: Resume public retrieval after client interruption
cases.task: Start one bounded public retrieval; save the returned job or tab ID, stop polling for 30 seconds, then reattach to the same job or tab without restarting it. Recover the result exactly once.
cases.source: Prior public transcript target
cases.ground_truth: Freeze expected answers from rendered page and authoritative source at run time; record adjudicator and content version.
cases.aggregation_note: Persistence feature score only; exclude from access score. If a true job is needed for disconnect recovery, record native mode as capability-not-applicable.
cases.precondition_note: A 30-second no-poll interval tests continuity, not a server restart or a proven network disconnect. Record interruption kind precisely.
